title: Preserve the requirement and acceptance reference before implementation
summary: Before implementation preserve the user requirement, reproduced failure, expected behavior, evaluation version, allowed files/subsystem, required evidence and stop conditions.
body: Before implementation preserve the user requirement, reproduced failure, expected behavior, evaluation version, allowed files/subsystem, required evidence and stop conditions. A worker may add tests but cannot silently change that reference. Reference changes are proposed design changes, never a way to relabel a failure as a pass. Worker completion is a submission; controller evidence checks and specified evaluations establish technical readiness, and Lohith separately accepts the result.
